scope: Local optimizer diagnostic, existing validation selection only. Training monotonicity is algorithm audit, not generalization. No convergence/global optimum claim on budget stop. No fresh or intact eval.
design: Per18-group kernel ridge on first768docs; next128 choose one ridge per family/kernel, final128 evaluation. Interaction phi=uz outer vz minus ux outer vx, u=core96 projection, v=orthogonal to core96 and frozen partner64. Additive midpoint/difference u/v blocks normalized by training mean squared norms. Each kernel normalized by training mean diagonal. No intercept. Native coefficients not used in fitting, targets are cached native-supervised missed responses.
